name: nitrogen_van_der_waals
title: Van der Waals equation of state for nitrogen
summary: Single state of nitrogen at the reduced conditions P_r = 1.2, T_r = 1.2: specific volume and compressibility factor from the van der Waals equation of state, compared with the built-in real-fluid properties (2.9 % volume deviation at this state).

origin.course: Thermodynamics (Klein & Nellis, Cambridge University Press, 2011), example 10.1-1

verification.summary: A copy of the converted model run at the state stored in the EES file (P_r = 40, T_r = 1.2) was compared with the stored solution (ees_variables.csv, --ees-units, K->°C): 12 common variables, 0 differ at rtol=0.001; v 1.19e-05, Z 7.51e-09, v_EES 2.86e-06, Z_EES 1.47e-05, max 2.38e-05 on a (EES R# = 8314.34 vs CoolSolve 8314.462618 J/kmol-K).
verification.reference: EES stored solution in example_10.1-1.eez (Variable Information records of the file)
verification.notes: Shipped model runs at P_r = 1.2 (single point of the card); the EES stored solution is a stale P_r = 40 run, so the comparison used a temporary copy at P_r = 40 (deleted with the work folder). v and Z of the shipped point re-checked by hand.
